messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: sev=high — 'tp-collective stall' on prod-gpu-pool detected for pod model-serving-rc-22. Symptoms: repeated collectives timing out, kernel crashes, pod restarts. Please acknowledge and follow runbook.

lee: acked. I'm oncall SRE. pinging @sam (ML infra) and @nidhi (runtime). any immediate customer impact known?

sam: seeing elevated 5xxs and queueing on API gateway. Some long-running inference jobs in dedicated pools are stuck. Not a full outage but high error rate for ~2 nodes.

nidhi: I'll join. initial glance at node events shows repeated '", cudaErrorUnknown(700)" and NCCL TIMEOUT while forming communicator. Also a couple of GPU OOMs prior to communicator failures. attaching short logs below.

alexa: +1 on delta; customers reporting latency spikes in EU region. throttling rules kicked in for some tenants.

lee: paste logs (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T18:25:03Z] model-serving-rc-22: NCCL WARN Call to cudaLaunchKernel returned error 700, aborting
[2026-03-15T18:25:04Z] model-serving-rc-22: NCCL INFO NCCL comm init timeout after 120s
[2026-03-15T18:25:05Z] container: runtime: failed with exit code 137 (OOM) - kernel killed process
```

sam: looks like warmup/batch sequence created a spike in memory use and then the NCCL rendezvous timed out while trying to form the communicator across 4 GPUs. we've seen similar when a single GPU OOMs and others get stuck waiting on collective.

ops_sre: oncall notes — affected nodes: prod-gpu-node-17, prod-gpu-node-18; 6 pods restarted in last 7m. Eviction/oom score ramped. I'm isolating those nodes in LB rotation.

lee: mitigation plan (short): 1) remove affected nodes from serving pool, 2) roll pods to single-gpu variant in the affected pool (fallback), 3) disable async collective optimization for the next rollout if confirmed, 4) if churn persists, scale up dedicated single-gpu workers temporarily. executing step 1 now.

alexa: FYI routing change reduced customer 5xx by ~40% already.

nidhi: quick hotfix we can flip: set ENV NCCL_LAUNCH_MODE=GROUP and NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=0 on the model-serving image, and disable the multi-gpu warmup path. I'll prepare a canary image and a rollout plan. this should avoid partial communicator bootstrap failures while we root-cause.

sam: sounds reasonable. any risk to correctness from disabling async error handling? small, acceptable for mitigation. prefer canary to 1 pod first.

lee: deploying drain+cordon on node-17, node-18. kubectl commands used:
```
kubectl drain prod-gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
kubectl cordon prod-gpu-node-17
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-serving -n prod --selector=pool=gpuprod
```

deploy-bot: Started rollout: deployment/model-serving @ 1999990035 -> image:gcr.io/redwood/model-serving:canary-nccl-fix

sam: canary pod started. logs show reduced NCCL negotiation attempts and no immediate timeout after 30s. monitoring for 5m.

lee: after canary looks good, prepared to scale rollout and then revert node cordon. moving to step 2.

alexa: customers on EU reduced errors to near baseline after canary. tagging affected accounts for postmortem.

ops_sre: scaling up single-gpu workers by +10 in gpuprod pool to absorb traffic while full rollout ongoing.

nidhi: note: I'll collect core dumps and nvcrash logs for offline analysis. capturing liveness and dmesg from affected nodes.

lee: timeline note: incident opened 1999990000, mitigation in place 1999990060, canary pass 1999990080, full rollout completed 1999990110. Will keep thread open for follow-up.

sam: assigning postmortem owners: @nidhi (root cause analysis), @lee (mitigation timeline & runbook gaps), @alexa (customer comms). target doc by EOD +48h.

alexa: sending brief customer-facing summary to CS and support now. informing two enterprise customers that saw degraded perf.

ops_sre: uncordoning node-17 after verification. recommend a hardware-level sanity check during maintenance window; adding to ops backlog.

lee: closing pager: if nothing regresses in 1h, we'll mark incident resolved. thanks all for quick triage :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: tp-collective stall on prod-gpu-pool — status: mitigated. runbook ref: /runbooks/tp-collective-stalls. tags: nccl,multigpu,oom,hotfix
